sahneler.metin: Hurricane Maria tore across Puerto Rico.
Suddenly the island's entire power grid went dark.
It became the worst blackout in US history.
The utility was already deep in debt.
It had lost a large part of its workforce.
An estimated two thousand nine hundred seventy five people died in Puerto Rico.
The grid became a case study in resilience.

aciklama:
Maria knocked out Puerto Rico's power grid for months. The cause: a fragile, underfunded grid destroyed and slow to restore.

#shorts #engineering #infrastructure

soru: Is resilience built before the storm?
